name: Topkapı Palace
_about: TOPKAPI PALACE, Istanbul (15th-19th c.), along its promontory from OpenStreetMap's plan (tools/archgen/topkapi.py): the Imperial Gate in the Sur-ı Sultani and the First Court rising to the Gate of Salutation between its two capped towers; the Second Court with its porticoes, the Imperial Council's three domes under the Tower of Justice, the Outer Treasury, Sinan's kitchens with twenty chimneys, the Harem to the north-west; the Gate of Felicity's canopy, the Third Court with the Audience Chamber in its colonnade, the Library of Ahmed III, the Mosque of the Agas, the dormitories, the Conqueror's Pavilion and the Pavilion of the Holy Mantle; the Fourth Court's marble terrace with its pool, the Baghdad and Revan kiosks, the Circumcision Room and the Iftariye, the lower garden with the Sofa Kiosk and the Mecidiye; Hagia Irene in the First Court. +x along the axis (NNE), +z the Marmara side.

first court._about: THE FIRST COURT (Alay Meydanı): the ground rising 8 m along the 330 m from the Imperial Gate to the Gate of Salutation, inside OSM's walls and fronts

mint yard._about: the Imperial Mint's precinct (the Darphane) behind its wall, on the same slope

irene yard._about: Hagia Irene's sunken yard at the old ground, the court's retaining wall round it

plateau._about: the palace's plateau (OSM's outline of the palace, way 335415778): the Second and Third Courts and the Harem, its faces the terrace walls over the slopes

plateau east._about: the plateau's stretch from the Fourth Court's wall to the marble terrace

plateau north._about: the plateau's stretch along the Conqueror's Pavilion

lower garden 1._about: the Fourth Court's lower garden (the tulip garden, the Sofa Kiosk, the Mecidiye), 5 m under the marble terrace

marble terrace._about: the Fourth Court's marble terrace: the Baghdad Kiosk on its corner, the Revan Kiosk, the Circumcision Room, the Iftariye on its edge and the pool, over the gardens

hillside._about: THE HILLSIDE round the palace's walls, falling to the shore and to Gülhane (a height map from the walls' lines)

terrace stair._about: the stair from the marble terrace down into the tulip garden, beside the Sofa Kiosk

garden stair._about: the stair from the Third Court's north-east corner down into the lower garden

imperial gate._about: the IMPERIAL GATE (Bâb-ı Hümâyûn, 1478): the marble block in the Sur-ı Sultani, OSM's 41 x 15 m, the passage through its middle (its upper storey of timber, gone since 1866, not built)

imperial gate niche._about: the deep pointed arch framing the passage on the outer face, its marble frame standing proud

imperial gate passage walls._about: the passage's side walls, the guard rooms behind them

sur-i sultani north 1._about: the Sur-ı Sultani, the palace's land wall, north from the Imperial Gate (OSM way 103339336)

sur-i sultani south 1._about: the Sur-ı Sultani south of the gate, toward the Marmara

mint wall 1._about: the wall along the road's south side, round the Imperial Mint's precinct (OSM way 335364924)

first court road._about: the road through the First Court, paved

irene atrium._about: HAGIA IRENE's atrium, the arcaded court before the church

irene._about: the church: the aisles and galleries' block, round-headed windows in two rows

irene main tower._about: the square the dome stands on, over the church's roofs

irene main dome._about: the main dome, 15 m across, 35 m up

irene west tower._about: the square the dome stands on, over the church's roofs

irene west dome._about: the lower dome over the west bay

kimyahane._about: the Kimyahane on the First Court (OSM way 103907803)

kimyahane roof._about: its lead roof, the eave out past the walls

firincilar roof._about: its lead roof, the eave out past the walls

gate wall._about: the Middle Gate's crenellated wall, the court's wall on the First Court's side, the passage through it at the origin

gate towers._about: the two octagonal towers either side of the passage (OSM's bumps: 5 m across, 18.35 m apart), under their pointed lead caps

gate porch._about: the porch before the passage on the First Court's side

gate hall._about: the hall the passage runs through, from the gate wall to the court

guard rooms north._about: the guard rooms either side of the gate hall

guard rooms south._about: the guard rooms either side of the gate hall

gate inner portico._about: the portico on the gate's court side, its broad eave over the passage's mouth

gate wall north._about: the rooms along the court's wall

gate wall south._about: the rooms along the court's wall

kitchen portico._about: the portico all down the kitchens' side, the three kitchen gates in the range behind it

felicity portico south._about: the portico south of the Gate of Felicity

felicity portico north._about: the portico north of it, to the range's corner

nw portico._about: the portico along the court's north-west side (OSM's roof, way 1396051571), its back wall over the stables' yard

divan portico._about: the Divan's portico under its deep painted eave (OSM's roof, way 335402671)

divan portico west._about: its wing before the Tower of Justice and the Carriage Gate to the Harem

kitchen range._about: the range between the portico and the kitchen street (OSM's strip, 6 m), its three gates

kitchens._about: Sinan's kitchens on the street: ten domed halls (OSM: 21.4 m deep in two rows, 105 m long), a door into each, a chimney on every dome

kitchens rear._about: the seaward row: ten more domes and chimneys

confectionery._about: the confectionery (helvahane) and its row at the street's south-west end: five domes

larders._about: the range closing the kitchens' north-east end

divan._about: the Kubbealtı: the council chamber, the chancery and the Defterhane, three domed rooms (OSM 26.6 x 11.8 m)

tower of justice._about: the Tower of Justice (OSM 8.8 x 8.4 m), the palace's tallest, 44 m: the stone shaft, Mahmud II's marble stage (1825: a tall arched window between paired columns in every face, segmental pediments) and the slender lead cone

treasury._about: the Outer Treasury's court-side row of four domes, stone and brick (OSM 32.3 x 17.7 m)

treasury rear._about: its back row, opening into the first through the spine's arches: eight domes in all

halberdiers._about: the dormitory of the halberdiers with tresses and the range along the palace's north-west wall over the stables (OSM way 32396154)

halberdiers roof._about: its lead roof, the eave out past the walls

carriage gate._about: the Carriage Gate into the Harem, by the Tower of Justice

harem eunuchs._about: THE HAREM: the Black Eunuchs' quarters round their court, by the Carriage Gate

harem concubines._about: the Concubines' court and their dormitory and baths over the Golden Horn

harem mosque range._about: the range between, the eunuchs' mosque

harem valide._about: the Valide Sultan's apartments round her court

harem imperial hall._about: the Imperial Hall (Hünkâr Sofası), the Sultan's baths

harem privy._about: Murad III's Privy Chamber, the Twin Kiosk, the Favourites' court

harem road range._about: the range along the Golden Road's south side, against the Third Court

harem court a._about: the Valide Sultan's court, paved (the Harem is built as its massing: its courts are seen, not walked into)

harem court b._about: the Black Eunuchs' court, paved (the Harem is built as its massing: its courts are seen, not walked into)

harem court c._about: the Concubines' court, paved (the Harem is built as its massing: its courts are seen, not walked into)

harem garden court._about: the court the Harem's ranges close against the outer wall (outside OSM's Harem, inside the palace's), paved

golden road._about: the Golden Road (Altın Yol), the Harem's lane from its gate to the Third Court, paved

harem windows._about: the Harem's windows, two storeys, on its outer faces

harem domes 1.6._about: the small domes over the Harem's rooms and baths

harem domes 2.2._about: the small domes over the Harem's rooms and baths

harem domes 2.9._about: the small domes over the Harem's rooms and baths

harem upper room 1._about: a raised room over the roofs

harem tower._about: the Harem's tower (the Tower of the Favourites)

felicity range._about: the range closing the Second Court, the Gate of Felicity through it

felicity north._about: its end behind the Outer Treasury

felicity gate._about: the Gate of Felicity's canopy (OSM 16.4 x 6.7 m): marble columns, the deep eave, the dome over the passage

audience chamber._about: the Arz Odası: the throne room in its colonnade of 22 columns under the deep roof (OSM's outline its eaves: 29.2 x 31.3 m), facing the gate

library basement._about: the LIBRARY OF AHMED III (1719) on its low basement (OSM way 32396231)

library._about: the domed reading hall at the cross's middle, an arch into every arm

library porch._about: the porch, the cross's fourth arm, toward the Audience Chamber

library stair north._about: a flight up to the porch from either side

library stair south._about: a flight up to the porch from either side

agas mosque._about: the Mosque of the Agas (OSM way 32396236), turned to Mecca across the court's lines

has oda dorm._about: the dormitory of the Privy Chamber's pages along the court's north-west side

dorm ne1._about: a dormitory on the Third Court's north-east side

seferli._about: the Dormitory of the Expeditionary Force (1635)

treasury pavilion._about: the CONQUEROR'S PAVILION (c. 1460), the Imperial Treasury: two floors, four domed rooms

treasury loggia._about: its loggia of arches over the Marmara, the terrace before the treasury's rooms

holy mantle._about: the PAVILION OF THE HOLY MANTLE (Has Oda, Mehmed II's privy chambers, the relics' rooms)

holy mantle porch._about: the domed porch with its fountain before the chambers

baghdad kiosk._about: the BAGHDAD KIOSK (1638-39): the domed octagon widened by four iwans, in its colonnade of marble columns under the deep eaves (OSM 26 x 25 m, its eaves)

revan kiosk._about: the REVAN KIOSK (1635): the domed room in its portico on the terrace (OSM 12.3 x 20.2 m)

circumcision room._about: the CIRCUMCISION ROOM (1641): the tiled room under its eaved roof (OSM 16 x 13.3 m)

iftariye columns._about: the IFTARIYE's four bronze posts on the terrace's edge

pool rim._about: the marble pool before the Revan Kiosk, its rim

mecidiye kiosk._about: the MECIDIYE KIOSK (1840, Abdülmecid): the last pavilion, European in its two storeys of round-headed windows, over the Marmara

fourth court wall 1._about: the wall between the Harem and the Fourth Court (OSM way 335415774)
